how: Members call for building the flag, daytime participation and defence of shared pictures.
Participants propose national pictures and revise lettering while retaining disagreement over which version to build.
A participant reports repairing a pixel while describing continuing attempts to alter the flag.
Coordinates and templates locate proposed work and make it actionable for other placers.
Guarding, warnings and repair maintain an alterable flag and eagle.
Members distinguish coordinated activity from spontaneous expansion and disown attacks attributed to outsiders.
Members propose avoiding neighbouring art, respecting a ceasefire, refusing attacks and apologising for damage attributed to other placers.
Visitors and residents negotiate restraint, assistance and compromise over overlapping pictures.
Members propose consuming neighbouring pictures, drawing a swastika and destroying nearby logos as a defensive buffer.
A proposal to draw lower around a resistant neighbour does not document the specified relocation after erasure or loss.
Participants announce success and thank one another for shared play, guarding and cooperation.
Participants narrate the start, reconstruct a battle and mourn an inscription consumed by the flag.
A member offers a replacement canvas, while another proposes earlier organisation next time, without establishing adoption of either proposal.
Tool recommendations and permission talk require evidence of execution before they establish automated placement or its effects.
A restraint proposal receives bare assent and a common-defence proposal receives a short commitment to try.
Members offer reciprocal help, report repairing a neighbour's logo, request assistance and greet collaborators.
Members recount mutual defence in a coalition and credit allies with survival they probably could not individually secure.
A neighbour answers an ultimatum with refusal, carrying the dispute in reciprocal talk.
References to pictures across the flag and resentment of leadership do not establish guest subjection to a host's approval rules.
Members propose a general thread, deletion of separate posts, a megathread and a filterable tag to contain canvas discussion.
A speaker qualifies acceptance by disclaiming authority over every member, while others state limits in response to complaints.
After closure, members contest the retained account of achievement through competing claims about leaders, allies and disobedient placers.
Members invite builders into chat, answer plan questions with invitations and direct people to pinned instructions.
A reply explains that the feature differs from ordinary Reddit and requires cooperation to make something large.
A greeting from an allied participant after cooperation supports visiting through joint work without establishing recruitment or lasting membership.
Mock battle history, colonial dreams and exaggerated diplomacy make canvas work material for humorous retelling.
Participants propose building lower or around a resistant neighbour without invoking a documented prior loss.
Invitations to a flag chat establish a venue but do not recover the formation or constitution of an autonomous canvas room.
A swastika-drawing call and an anti-witch-hunt correction do not establish refusal of hate symbols or correction of offensive canvas language.
A Minecraft-version screenshot does not establish directed outreach to creators, a company or the press outside the canvas.
Members disagree whether recolouring an earlier rainbow destroys others' work or continues its idea as play.
A question suggesting that people are resting does not establish a participant's withdrawal under strain or a repaired quarrel.
Writing Polish for a neighbour's negotiations does not establish secret strategy, coding or infiltration.
Post-flood complaints, diversion recruitment and self-reported sabotage do not establish that objection to canvas posts motivated destructive action.
Members investigate missing arrows, perform a quotation game and judge familiar pranks in the host's separate April Fools conduct.
Members judge maintenance capacity and whether two placers can make new art recognisable before others mistake it for vandalism.
Historical attack language does not establish an actual pre-canvas quarrel carried into the event by these participants.
Participants use national and political frames while disputing whether the canvas project is nationalist competition or shared play.
Members acknowledge substantial effort and lost pixels during the event without establishing specific sleep, work or device constraints.
Script permission talk does not report a faulty canvas, timer or client, leaving technical failures unobserved in these concepts.
Supporting another group on hardware-performance grounds does not establish membership in both groups.
Explicit references to leaders and command establish discussed order without determining appointment procedures or authority over all placers.
An attack proposal invokes national history in its own wording without establishing enduring hostility between the participants.
A member's initial proposal establishes the revised starter role independently of whether other people subsequently join.
Members provide translation for another group's negotiations and report contacting neighbours without thereby gaining universal representative authority.
Routing plans into chat conditions one participant's choice to limit contributions to conservation when they do not use that venue.
A proposal to publish suspected placers' names meets an anti-witch-hunt rule and is repurposed as recruitment for future diversions.
Renewal can seek another shared activity rather than retaining a picture, and the proposal can elicit reminders of the canvas flood and possible fatigue.
Competing designs and repaired sabotage require further evidence before repair can be attributed to keepers lacking notice of an agreed change.
Boundary proposals remain disputed and may be withdrawn, so they cannot establish implementation of a unified removal policy.
The joking frame can coexist with disagreement within moderation and the organiser's withdrawal rather than unanimous consent.

statement: Soliciting evaluation of an inaccessible canvas picture without a recoverable organising object.
how: The surviving request for an opinion is observable, while the picture's identity and the request's consequence remain unresolved.
Calls and later repair reports do not establish which call caused a member to join or perform the work.
The initial proposal is itself a call, leaving a distinct starter-to-recruitment sequence unestablished.
Upkeep overlaps achievement because announcing success does not remove the continuing need to repair overwrites.
A participant explicitly connects the flag's inevitable encounter with neighbours to seeking agreement.
A ceasefire is explicitly offered as a reason to respect the neighbour's work.
Treaty-based restraint cannot be assumed beyond participating placers because acceptance disclaims universal authority and other people continue overwriting protected work.
Maintenance pressure and tool circulation coexist without a passage linking manual overload to actual automated deployment.
Completion reports and celebration can occur within one turn rather than as separate successive stages.
Recording during ongoing placement does not establish that celebration caused preservation.
The final announcement, meme-day proposal and clone offer do not establish that preserving a record caused an adopted continuation.
Capacity doubts do not document subsequent abandonment and relocation.
A template settles a design only with shared acceptance because template requests and concurrent letter versions do not establish agreement.
A common-defence proposal receives a short commitment to try without demonstrating that every reader supplies or owes an answer.
A shortage-based appeal and later testimony of allied help do not recover the specific recruitment and delivery mechanism.
A reciprocal offer receives qualified acceptance and a report of repair in the same negotiation.
Recruitment and attack proposals do not establish that the original call redirected recruited hands toward attack.
Attack proposals receive both a bare refusal with a chat invite and a reasoned appeal to remain together against a shared threat.
The attack refusals do not document a newly negotiated truce arising from an attack proposal.
An ultimatum and refusal establish contest in talk but require further evidence before implying an executed pixel attack.
Coalition survival is a participant's retrospective explanation while the membership decision and its timing remain unavailable.
A complaint explicitly connects a page full of canvas posts to the request for one general discussion thread.
The disclaimer occurs within acceptance, instantiating the revised contemporaneous-disclaimer bound rather than a separate dispute after an agreement.
